verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs describe it as a free, self-hosted, MIT-licensed Git service that runs on many OSes and architectures, ships as a single binary or an official container image, and supports single-server or replicated deployments. Many independent hands-on reports confirm easy self-hosting on VPSes, Raspberry-Pi-class hardware, Docker, and USB sticks, plus simple binary-swap upgrades.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Full control, unlimited users and repositories.
or use container (docker/podman/etc) to deploy on your own server with the official image.
This makes it convenient for individual developers or small teams to set up and manage their own Git services.
Upgrades are super simple: stop the service, replace the single binary, start it again.
